result.quote: “Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?”
result.reason: The key accurately paraphrases the officer’s rhetorical claim that the predicted event seemed impossible even if the LORD made windows in heaven. No different answer is defensible. However, the window calls the speaker “the officer,” not “the captain,” so that title is unsupported; “What did the officer say to Elisha?” would align with the text.
